task: Implement the P4 Advanced Arena core on completion/advanced-arena, preserving P3 HEAD 1e2e40ac560973e102f44a6b7cb9ed70d5a68800. Add a bounded, deterministic advanced-arena domain/module and SQLite persistence/migration for real Arena evidence: rankings by category and metric (objective pass rate, duration/tokens where present, human score), regression comparison between saved Arena summaries/benchmark versions with deltas and uncertainty, Tournament Mode scheduling for 1v1 and bounded round-robin or single-elimination, blind ranking inputs/outputs, optional judge score ingestion, calibration metrics, and explicit human-vs-judge disagreement handling. No external AI/network calls in this turn; optional AI judge must be represented as an explicit provider-unavailable/score-input boundary, never fabricated. Run cargo fmt/check/test, npm typecheck/test/build, git diff --check, then create one focused local commit. No P5 BYOK, no P6 redesign, no P7 packaging, no merge/tag/release/deploy/public release.
